# Changelog

Newest release first. Each entry says what it was, what it is now and, where something has to change in your program or build, how to migrate. Pull request numbers link to the full description. "Not verified" marks what has only been tested in CI, under Wine, or by reading the original source, and not on the real thing.

## 2.1 (unreleased)

Everything merged into `root` since 2.0 (`2026.11.27.28792`).

### Fixes

- **`blitzcc file.bb <arguments>` runs the program with those arguments** ([#762](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/762)). Was: anything after the file that wasn't an option stopped blitzcc with "Only one input file is supported", so the original IDE's command line (`blitzcc -q file.bb <program arguments>`) failed. Now: like the original, everything from the first word after the file that isn't a blitzcc option goes to the program (`CommandLine$`), including words starting with `-`. blitzcc options after the file (`-o game`) still count. `--args` still works.
- **Any number of textures works with the Vulkan renderer** ([#759](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/759)).
  Was: every texture takes a binding group from one fixed pool with room for 8193, so the 8194th texture (for example 10000 cubes with a texture each) stopped the program with "vkAllocateDescriptorSets (too many textures?) failed (VkResult -1000069000)". Now: when that pool is full, more pools of 1000 groups are added as needed, and freed groups are used again. Migrate: nothing. OpenGL and Direct3D 11 had no such limit.
- **`TurnEntity` is cheaper again** ([#760](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/760)). Was: since the own-axes fix of 2.0 ([#741](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/741)) every turn built two rotation matrices and read the Euler angles back (about 105 ns, 6 ns before). Now: turns about one axis that equal adding one angle (a roll, a yaw in the world without a parent, a yaw or pitch while the angles after it are 0) only add it, and other turns do less matrix work (about 71 ns). The angles that come out are the same. On Irkela spacebattle's effects part (1516 turns per frame) went from 0.34 to 0.25 ms. When: a program turns thousands of entities each frame; prefer one-axis turns where they do the job.

## 2.0 (2026.11.27.28792)

Everything merged into `root` between 1.0 (`2026.11.5.23019`) and 2.0.

### Things that can break existing programs

- **`Graphics`, `Graphics3D` and `EndGraphics` free the program's graphics** ([#630](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/630)).
  Was: a second `Graphics` call kept every entity, brush, texture, image and font. Now: they are freed and `Dither`, `AntiAlias`, `WireFrame`, collision rules, `AmbientLight` and texture filters are reset, as in Blitz3D. Sounds stay.
  Migrate: pass the new 5th argument `keep` (`Graphics3D w, h, d, mode, True`) to keep everything across a resolution change. Programs from original BlitzPlus, which kept images and fonts, compile with `--blitzplus`.
- **`Const` has its value everywhere** ([#631](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/631)).
  Was: a `Const` used above its declaration read as 0. Now: all Consts are folded before the program runs, in any order, like the original. A Const that depends on itself is an error. Migrate: nothing, unless a program relied on the 0.
- **`CameraCulling` starts at 1** ([#658](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/658)).
  Was: GPU culling of the faces of big meshes was on. Now: only whole meshes are frustum culled. Migrate: `CameraCulling camera, 3` turns the GPU culling back on.
- **Physics queries see bodies as the last `PhysicsUpdate` left them** ([#615](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/615)).
  Was: every query first took over moved entities. Now: only `PhysicsUpdate` does (`PhysicsUpdate 0` takes moves over without a step). Migrate: call `PhysicsUpdate 0` after moving bodies and before querying.
- **`PhysicsOverlapBox` has three more arguments** (pitch, yaw, roll) before the optional ones ([#600](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/600)). Migrate: calls that pass the optional arguments by position need the three new ones.
- **BlitzPlus `CreateWindow` draws no fake desktop** ([#617](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/617)).
  Was: when no operating system window could be made, the window was drawn inside the Graphics window, and GUI redraws painted RGB(58,110,165) over the program's picture. Now: `CreateWindow` returns 0, `RequestColor` and `RequestFont` open their own window, and the GUI neither draws in nor reads input from the Graphics window. Migrate: check the result of `CreateWindow`.
- **`Dither 2` is gone** ([#504](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/504)). Values above 1 count as 1, `HWDither` still returns 1. Migrate: use a 10 or 16 bit buffer where banding shows.
- **Only the direction of a vertex normal is kept** ([#653](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/653)). Was: `VertexNormal 0.5, 0, 0` read back as 0.5, 0, 0. Now: 1, 0, 0 (normals are stored in 32 bits). Drawing is unchanged.
- **`blitzcc` names the program it compiles and runs `blitzllvm_` plus 12 random hex digits** ([#680](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/680)), because Windows and NVIDIA recognise some executable names as games and force VSync or Auto HDR. With `-o` the name you give is used.
- **Programs built for Windows without `-g` carry no symbols** ([#674](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/674)), and the static SDL3 no longer honours `SDL3_DYNAMIC_API` ([#677](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/677)). Both make programs smaller. Migrate: build with `-g` to get symbols.
- **Linux is released as Flatpak only** (`com.xaymar.BlitzLLVM`, with the runtime extension `com.xaymar.BlitzLLVM.Runtime`); deb, rpm, Arch and snap packages are gone ([#460](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/460)). A Flatpak builds programs for its own architecture; another target needs your own clang through `BLITZLLVM_CC`. There is a game template in `packaging/flatpak/game-template`. Not published to a repository yet.
- **One Windows package for x64 and arm64** ([#528](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/528)): `bin/x86_64` and `bin/arm64`, with shared `runtime` and `mingw` folders. The setup installs the tools of the computer's architecture. Smaller since [#571](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/571) (only the needed import libraries and headers). Not verified: arm64 install.

### Compatibility with the original Blitz3D and BlitzPlus

Each of these made a program from the original behave differently.

- `TurnEntity` multiplies the turn onto the entity's rotation like the original, instead of adding to its Euler angles ([#741](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/741)). Was: right while the entity had a single angle, wrong for turns around two axes (an old rolling-ball example).
- `Return` in the main program with no `Gosub` to go back to ends the program like `End` ([#734](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/734)). Was: a compile error without any `Gosub`, and "Return without Gosub" with one. `Return value` in the main program is still an error.
- A texture or blend set on an entity replaces that of its model's surface, as in the original ([#713](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/713)). Was: the surface's texture won over `EntityTexture`, so a masked texture could draw unmasked and `EntityBlend` did nothing on surfaces with a blend.
- `blitzcc -k`, `+k` and `--dump-keywords` print the commands with their real case and the original's parameter names ([#714](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/714)). Was: all lower case, `param1`, `param2`.
- `EntityParent` with `global=True` keeps rotation and scale, not only the position ([#556](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/556)).
- Collisions: a new entity no longer inherits those of a freed one ([#554](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/554)); hits told to an entity with a higher handle than the mover are no longer lost in `UpdateWorld` ([#555](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/555)).
- `SetBuffer TextureBuffer(tex)` works for 2D commands without flag 4096. Only `RenderWorld` into such a texture is an error in debug builds ([#557](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/557)).
- `.3ds` loading: one vertex per vertex of the file ([#559](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/559)) and no tint on materials with a picture ([#561](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/561)).
- A surface with several textures is see-through only after `EntityBlend`/`BrushBlend 1` and when a texture has alpha ([#562](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/562)).
- `HidePointer` before `Graphics` is kept ([#563](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/563)), and works with the window thread ([#634](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/634)).
- The `AppTitle` close prompt survives `EndGraphics` ([#560](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/560)); `AppTitle` before `Graphics` names the window ([#511](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/511)).
- `PlaySound`, `EmitSound` and related commands ignore sound 0 in debug builds too ([#576](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/576)); a second `FreeSound` is ignored ([#531](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/531)). Sound 0 was taken from a bug report (Stranded 2), not checked against the original.
- `CreateSphere(2)` makes a 2-segment sphere and the caps on segment counts (plane 20, others 100) are gone ([#598](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/598)).
- `Type` fields accept a default (`Field x% = 5`) like the original, which parses it and ignores it. `--field-defaults` applies it ([#699](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/699)).
- Original BlitzPlus `HtmlView` commands are no longer marked as extensions ([#685](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/685)).
- `blitz-recompiler` converts executables made by the original compilers ([#147](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/147)), converts Int/Float arguments, masks texture flags and limits flags and modes to the values the original knew ([#702](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/702), [#712](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/712)).

### New commands and language features

- **Physics (Jolt):** `Physics...` commands for rigid bodies, own worlds, solvers and constraints ([#481](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/481), [#482](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/482), [#518](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/518), [#520](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/520)); ray casts, point/overlap queries, contact reports and shape casts ([#518](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/518), [#600](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/600)). Separate from `EntityType` collisions and picks. No character controller.
- **Audio buses and scenes:** `CreateAudioBus`, `AudioBusVolume` (with fades), `ChannelBus`, `SoundBus`, `MusicBus`, `PauseAudioBus` and more; a channel's loudness is its own volume times that of every bus up to the master ([#717](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/717)). Audio scenes (`CreateAudioScene`, `CaptureAudioScene`, `ApplyAudioScene`, `BlendAudioScene`) hold bus volumes and listener settings and fade between them ([#720](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/720)). Movie sound plays on the mixer too: `MovieChannel`, `MovieBus`, `EmitMovie` ([#722](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/722)). Shipped include file `audio.bb` has the constants.
- **Audio effects:** effects on buses ([#742](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/742)), and effects, sends and air absorption on channels (`AddChannelEffect`, `ChannelSend`, `ListenerAirAbsorption`, [#749](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/749)). Own DSP, parameters by number.
- **Modern mode (opt-in):** `;#pragma modern` or `--modern` turns on sane evaluation order, field defaults and entity overrides at once, and each can be switched on or off by name ([#715](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/715), [#740](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/740)). With entity overrides, `EntityColor`, `EntityAlpha`, `EntityFX` and `EntityShininess` replace the brush values instead of combining with them. Warning pragmas (`;#pragma Wno-NAME`, `warning(push)`, `warning(pop)`) change warnings from their line on, through `Include` ([#735](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/735)). Without a pragma nothing changes; see the Modern-Mode wiki page ([#738](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/738)).
- **Vectors and matrices** as value types: `FloatVector3`, `IntVector4`, `FloatMatrix4x3` and so on ([#587](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/587)). `a:Float[4]` still means an array of 5.
- **Cameras:** `SetCameraBuffer`/`GetCameraBuffer` ([#604](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/604)), `RenderCamera` ([#605](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/605)), projection and view matrices ([#607](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/607)), 6 clip planes per camera ([#608](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/608)).
- **Stencil buffers:** `SetCameraStencil`, `SetCameraStencilClear`, `SetEntityStencil`, `SetEntityStencilBack` ([#618](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/618)).
- **Normal maps:** `TextureBlend tex, 6` (OpenGL green up) and `7` (Direct3D green down) next to Dot3 ([#479](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/479)).
- **AutoHDR:** `SetGraphicsHDR`, `GetGraphicsHDR`, `HWHDRSupported`, `HWHDRPeakNits`, `HWHDRActive` ([#567](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/567), Vulkan and Direct3D 11). On an HDR window the gamma tables are applied in floating point, so buffers of depth 30 or 64 are no longer rounded to 8 bits, and `Dither` adds noise of one step of the display's bit depth ([#676](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/676)).
- **Frame rate:** `SetGraphicsRefreshRate`/`GetGraphicsRefreshRate` with a limiter in `Flip` ([#565](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/565)). Before: `CreateTimer`/`WaitTimer`, which polls every 1 ms. Present timing (`VK_EXT_present_timing`) is off unless `BLITZLLVM_PRESENT_TIMING=1`.
- **Sound:** `SetFalloff`, `SetChannelFalloff` (and `Get` forms) pick the SDL, FMOD 3 or SoLoud curve ([#530](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/530)); `ListenerRolloff`, `ListenerDoppler`, `ListenerDistance`, `ListenerRadius`, `SpeedOfSound` fade over time, plus `ListenerFalloff` and `ChannelDoppler` ([#701](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/701)). Doppler smoothing is 10 ms instead of 120 ms ([#558](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/558)).
- **Windows:** `SetWindowSizeLimit` ([#642](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/642)); the program keeps running while a window is dragged ([#586](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/586)); a click that brings a window to the front is delivered ([#637](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/637)); a resized window shows its picture at once ([#635](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/635)).
- `TotalVidMem64` and `AvailVidMem64` for more than 2 GB ([#514](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/514)).
- **Shipped include files:** `Include "<keys.bb>"` finds files in the installation, with constants for keys, mouse, joystick and the flags and modes of the commands (`BB_TEXTURE_*`, `BB_FX_*`, `BB_SHAPE_*` and more); the language server and VS Code know it ([#639](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/639), [#640](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/640), [#669](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/669)). Windows device names (`CON`, `NUL` and so on) are refused in any include path.
- `blitzcc --icon file.ico` gives a Windows program its own icon ([#581](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/581)); without it, programs get the BlitzLLVM icon ([#564](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/564)). Not verified: how icons look in Explorer and the installer on Windows.
- `blitz-format` rewrites code that the original rejects into code that both accept: one-line `If`s with a call before `Else` become blocks (`split-one-line-if`), and `weights#[0]` loses its suffix (`remove-array-suffix`). Both are on by default because they keep the program the same ([#707](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/707)).
- `-Wcompatibility` warns about code the original rejects: one-line `If ... Then Foo(1, 2) Else`, and `weights#[0]` ([#706](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/706)). Off by default.
- No warning for integer expressions known at compile time that convert exactly, such as `Rnd(-30, 30)` ([#597](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/597)).
- `SaveBuffer` and `SaveImage` show their `settings` argument in the docs ([#515](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/515)).

### Renderers

- **Direct3D 11** (Windows, [#551](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/551)) and **OpenGL 4.3** (Linux [#548](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/548), Windows [#578](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/578), [#582](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/582)) next to Vulkan. `BLITZLLVM_RENDERER` picks one (`vulkan`, `d3d11`, `opengl`, `auto`), `SystemProperty$("renderer")` tells which runs ([#541](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/541)).
- **`auto` (the default) takes the next renderer when Vulkan cannot start**: Vulkan, then Direct3D 11, then OpenGL ([#577](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/577)). Was: a machine without Vulkan 1.3 ended with an error.
- **Frame slots on OpenGL and Direct3D 11** ([#697](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/697)) fix objects drawn with other objects' meshes and textures on NVIDIA under Windows. Direct3D 11 uses flip-model swapchains and `Flip 2` draws unbound with VSync ([#694](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/694)).
- **Texture streaming:** when video memory is short, textures with mip maps lose their biggest levels first and get them back when memory frees up ([#478](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/478)); mesh buffers are defragmented ([#477](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/477)).
- All texture layers blend in one fragment shader. Dot3 on later layers is exact on every GPU. Layers now apply to see-through surfaces, and fog and highlights come after the last layer ([#506](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/506)). Surfaces with mipmapped layers no longer draw black ([#512](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/512)).
- Vertices shrink from 48 to 32 bytes ([#652](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/652), [#653](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/653), [#654](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/654)); faster uploads ([#649](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/649)), skinning ([#708](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/708), [#705](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/705)) and picks in busy scenes ([#691](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/691)). Vulkan frames sync with timeline semaphores ([#663](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/663)).
- Programs that only `Print` no longer link the renderer, and Windows programs drop unused code, which makes them much smaller ([#672](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/672), [#673](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/673)).
- Windows programs export `NvOptimusEnablementCuda` too ([#550](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/550)).

### Tooling and debugging

- Runtime errors in `-d` builds name the source file and line ([#553](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/553)). Not verified on Windows.
- Windows `-d` and `-g` builds write a `.pdb` again (CodeView with lld) ([#572](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/572)); debuggers show Strings, Types and Dim arrays ([#573](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/573)). A Dim array shows `Data` and counts, not a list of elements. Not verified: arm64 `.pdb`.
- `blitzcc -v` prints the commit hash after the version ([#693](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/693)).
- VS Code runs `blitzcc` and `blitz-lsp` from the Flatpak (setting `blitz.flatpak`); debugging with the Flatpak is not supported yet ([#566](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/566)). The language server knows commands that return `UInt64` ([#710](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/710)).
- The build runs through one script on every platform ([#696](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/696)), accepts CMake 3.28 and newer ([#683](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/683)), and every sample, tutorial and game is compiled in the tests ([#667](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/667)).

### Fixes

- Exit crash 0xC0000005 in `SDL_DestroyAudioQueue`: `EndGraphics` no longer shuts down all of SDL ([#575](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/575)).
- Missing C headers in the Windows package made the inline runtime build without it ([#584](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/584)); Direct3D 11 multisampled depth ([#585](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/585)).
- `AntiAlias 1` and `AntiAlias 2` (SMAA T2x) copied 24 bytes from a 12 byte camera position, so with a moving camera the previous picture was reprojected to the wrong place ([#747](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/747)).
- Wiki tables show every parameter and `""` defaults ([#689](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/689), [#690](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/690)); help media is stored as WebP and Ogg ([#698](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/698)).

### Samples, tutorials and documentation

- Tutorials in chapters (language, 2D, 3D, effects, BlitzPlus GUI), including Minesweeper, Solitaire and a falling block puzzle; samples and the original Blitz3D tutorials ship in the installs ([#619](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/619)).
- Games: Rally, Shatterwall, Ion Tide, Blockwright, Hoverline, Hullbreach, Ghost Run, Blitzard, Panewalk, Foldgate, Mage Tower (1 to 4 players, physics, wind and weather) ([#752](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/752)).
- Demos: Neon Plaza, a movie on a big screen with its sound coming from the screen ([#753](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/753)); Cave Echoes, a walk that shows audio effects, scenes and air absorption ([#754](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/754)).
- Designs only, nothing implemented yet: hand-written shader sources ([#591](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/591)), the vertex format ([#651](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/651)), modern mode pragmas and overrides ([#700](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/700), [#716](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/716)).

### Internal, no change for programs

The renderer is split into a backend interface (RHI, [#505](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/505) to [#544](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/544)); Direct3D 11 shaders compile to bytecode in the Windows build, and OpenGL gets its GLSL from the same shaders ([#545](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/545) to [#547](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/547)); CI caches downloads ([#513](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/513)).

## 1.0 (2026.11.5.23019)

First stable release: a compiler and runtime for Blitz3D, BlitzBasic and BlitzPlus programs on LLVM, Vulkan and SDL3. The list names what differs from the original compilers (Blitz3D 1.118, BlitzPlus), because a program written for the original runs unchanged unless an entry says otherwise. A fuller list is the generated *Differences* page of the wiki. Written from the pull request titles and the wiki's difference notes; the details of each are in the linked PRs.

### Time: use `Microseconds()`, not `MilliSecs()`, to measure a frame

- Was: `MilliSecs()` counts whole milliseconds, so one frame time is off by up to 1 ms, which is a large part of a frame at several hundred frames per second.
- Now: `Microseconds()` returns a `UInt64` count of millionths of a second, starting at 0 when the program starts, and it only goes forward (it does not follow the system clock) ([#495](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/495)). `--profile` and the `Profile*` commands measure the parts of a program and of the runtime ([#420](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/420)).
- Migrate: keep the result in a `:UInt64` variable. A variable with no type or with `%` is a 32-bit `Int` and overflows after 35 minutes; `#` is a `Float` and stops counting single microseconds after 16 seconds.

```blitzbasic
start:UInt64 = Microseconds()
; ... the work to measure ...
elapsed:UInt64 = Microseconds() - start
Print "Microseconds: " + elapsed
```

### Language and compiler

- **New number types** `Byte`, `UByte`, `Short`, `UShort`, `UInt`, `Long`, `ULong`, `Half`, `Double` work everywhere a type can be written, and literals take a suffix such as `255ui8` or `0.1.d` ([#484](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/484)). `Single(value)` is another name of `Float(value)` ([#446](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/446)). `0x` and `0b` literals that fit in 32 bits are `Int` ([#483](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/483)), and string to integer conversions read `$`, `0x`, `%` and `0b` ([#371](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/371)).
- **`Void`** is a return type of functions ([#259](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/259)), and parameters can be `In`, `Out` or `InOut` ([#264](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/264)).
- **Objects:** `Delete` frees at once when the last reference goes and sets the variable to `Null`; `Insert` works as an expression ([#379](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/379)). A command that is given a freed object reports "Object does not exist" in every build ([#410](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/410)). Duplicate Type fields are refused, also when only the case differs ([#362](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/362)).
- **Matching the original compiler:** calls and operators are evaluated in the original's order ([#220](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/220)), the `For` limit is evaluated again and the step is checked ([#221](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/221)), `EndSelect`, `EndFunction` and `EndType` are accepted as one word, empty `Else` and repeated colons work in a one-line `If` ([#178](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/178), [#436](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/436)), an included file is read once ([#218](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/218)), `Asc("")` returns -1 ([#396](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/396)).
- **Warnings** for a `For` counter whose type differs from the start, end or step (error with `-d`) ([#348](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/348)), and for local arrays over 4 KiB, which live on the heap ([#349](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/349)).
- **Tools:** `blitz-format` and `blitz-tidy` get alignment, wrapping and style rules ([#241](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/241)); a language server and a VS Code extension ([#435](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/435)). `blitzcc --dump-keywords` ([#260](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/260)), `--version` ([#309](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/309)). `-d` builds break into an attached debugger on a runtime error ([#486](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/486)).
- **Environment variables** all start with `BLITZLLVM_`; `=0` turns a switch off ([#292](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/292)). `SystemProperty$` knows `cpu`, `os`, `ram`, `runtime` and `timestamp` ([#492](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/492)).

### Graphics

- **Depth** acts like `WBuffer 1` of the original, which only a few cards had back then, and it is now the default: a reversed 32-bit float buffer, so distant surfaces z-fight much less. A surface can hold more than 65535 vertices. Up to 127 lights are visible per camera and every draw is lit by its best eight; light channels are 64 bits ([#209](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/209), [#380](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/380)). 3D colour commands take floats from 0 to 255.
- **`Graphics` and `Graphics3D` are the same command** and honour the depth: 8, 12, 15, 16, 24, 30, 32 and 64 bit pictures with the real pixel values ([#257](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/257), [#351](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/351)). `Dither` (with `DitherMode` and `DitherTemporal`) turns 8-bit output into noise instead of bands ([#256](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/256)). `AntiAlias` uses SMAA (1) and SMAA T2x (2) ([#361](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/361)).
- **Transparency:** see-through entities follow the original's order, depth and alpha rules ([#205](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/205)); `GraphicsOrderIndependentTransparency` offers modes 0 to 5 ([#394](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/394)); `SpriteDepthFade` and `EntityDepthFade` soften edges ([#229](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/229), [#359](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/359)); `TransparencyDistanceSortMode` ([#413](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/413)).
- **Lighting and fog:** `EntityLighting 1` lights per pixel ([#412](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/412)); `CameraFogMode camera, 2` is spherical fog ([#360](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/360)); `EntityLightChannel` ([#367](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/367)); BSP point and spot lights ([#428](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/428)).
- **Textures:** flags 1024 (point sampling), 2048 (sRGB) and 4096 (render target) work; flag 8 gives mip maps with trilinear filtering; samplers give anisotropy ([#225](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/225), [#227](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/227), [#228](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/228)). `TextureBlend` 0 and 4 work on layers like Direct3D 7 ([#400](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/400)).
- **Culling and speed:** `CameraCulling` and `CameraCullingSource` ([#238](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/238)), `EntityStatic` for GPU-driven draws ([#377](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/377)), a spatial grid ([#251](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/251)), loading on other threads with `AsyncLoading`, `TextureReady`, `ImageReady`, `EntityReady` ([#211](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/211), [#240](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/240)), video memory defragmentation ([#450](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/450)), a tiered memory allocator ([#252](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/252)) and optional CPU instruction sets chosen at run time (`BLITZLLVM_CPU`, [#389](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/389)). The program's own thread prefers the first CPU ([#447](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/447)).
- **Resilience:** a lost graphics device is made again; a machine without Vulkan 1.3 exits with an error ([#493](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/493)). Windows programs ask for the dedicated NVIDIA and AMD GPU ([#497](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/497)).
- **Pictures and models:** save PNG, JPEG, WebP, JPEG XL, TGA, DDS and BMP with settings ([#265](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/265), [#422](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/422)); load animated GIF, WebP and AVIF, TIFF, and glTF/GLB models ([#286](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/286), [#398](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/398), [#424](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/424)). JPEG 2000 is not read.
- **Collisions and picks** match the original's triangle order and results, checked against test oracles ([#296](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/296), [#391](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/391)); Jolt finds picks and the triangles near a mover ([#430](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/430), [#454](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/454)).
- `FrontBuffer()` and `BackBuffer()` are separate buffers again ([#490](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/490)).

### Input, windows, audio and network

- **Input:** all five mouse buttons, every DirectInput key code, `VKeyDown` and `VKeyHit` by SDL scancode ([#451](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/451), [#453](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/453)); device lists with hot-plug and an optional `Device` argument ([#404](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/404), [#406](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/406)); `LockMouse`/`UnlockMouse` ([#386](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/386)); `RawInput`, `HWRawInput`, `RawInputEnabled` replace the `RawInputs` names ([#385](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/385)).
- **BlitzPlus windows** are real windows of the operating system with their own thread, scaled with the display ([#409](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/409), [#437](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/437)); a program that only makes windows opens no Graphics window ([#432](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/432)).
- **Audio:** sounds are resampled cleanly, so low-rate sounds are duller (`BLITZLLVM_LEGACY_AUDIO_RESAMPLING` restores the FMOD sound); `BLITZLLVM_VOLUME_FALLOFF` picks the curve (`new`, `soloud`, `legacy`) ([#277](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/277)).
- **Network:** IPv6 works ([#452](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/452)). Multiplayer uses TCP on port 40500 instead of DirectPlay, so games only play with other BlitzLLVM games.
- **Physics:** `blitzphysics` (Jolt behind a C interface) is in the build ([#415](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/415)); the `Physics` commands themselves came in 2.0.

### Also in 1.0: pull requests merged by rebase

These PRs (26 to 28 October) were merged by rebase, so they have no merge commit in the history and are easy to miss there. Taken from the PR titles; the details are in each PR.

- **Movies** play through FFmpeg, with Opus sound: `PlayMovie`, `PauseMovie`, `StopMovie`, `LoopMovie`, `SeekMovie`, `MovieLength`, `MoviePosition`, `MovieVolume`, `GetMovieTexture`; `DrawMovie` returns whether the movie is still playing ([#125](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/125), [#133](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/133), [#169](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/169), [#175](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/175), [#298](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/298)).
- **Strings keep their length**: a string can hold `Chr(0)`, and files, network messages and command results keep it ([#282](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/282)). Was: text ended at the first zero byte, as in the original's C strings (my reading of the title). Migrate: nothing, unless a program relied on the cut.
- **Presentation:** `Flip 2` presents synced without waiting ([#288](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/288)); frames are submitted from their own thread ([#87](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/87)); `SetGfxDriver` chooses the GPU ([#105](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/105)); `GfxMode3DWidth`/`GfxMode3DHeight`, display and refresh rate listing and window mode 4, a window without a border ([#53](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/53), [#55](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/55), [#83](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/83)). Fullscreen is a borderless window that keeps the aspect ratio ([#161](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/161)). Mode lists always report 32 bits ([#101](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/101)) and `DesktopBuffer` does nothing ([#149](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/149)). `SetGamma` and `UpdateGamma` work without changing the system gamma ([#106](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/106)). Windows programs are DPI aware ([#148](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/148)).
- **Textures:** sampler commands ([#88](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/88)), texture transforms, sphere and cube maps ([#89](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/89)), mip maps ([#72](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/72)), DDS files ([#67](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/67)) and `LoadAtlas`/`AtlasTexture` ([#283](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/283)). Vertex colours are 16-bit floats ([#62](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/62), [#63](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/63)) and 3D meshes are drawn relative to the camera, so far away models keep their shape ([#76](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/76)). `Dither` and `WBuffer` became no-ops, and 64-bit pictures use half floats with `Float16` channels in `ReadPixel64`/`WritePixel64` ([#101](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/101), [#300](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/300)).
- **Models and lighting:** DirectX `.x` files ([#274](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/274)), `.3ds` with animations ([#81](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/81)), lighting that follows Blitz3D ([#47](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/47)), BSP levels with lightmaps ([#102](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/102)), `BSPLightmapColor` and `BSPAmbientLight` ([#139](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/139)). `CopyEntity` and sprites match the original ([#279](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/279), [#280](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/280)).
- **Fonts and GUI:** `LoadFont`, `Text` and `FontWidth` use real TrueType fonts, with a scroll bar for long text and tool tips ([#92](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/92)). The BlitzPlus GUI was first drawn by the runtime ([#10](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/10), [#108](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/108)) and later replaced by operating system windows (see above).
- **Audio:** Doppler shift for 3D sounds ([#110](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/110)), Opus files ([#78](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/78)), `EmitSound` panning and distance in render loops ([#272](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/272)). `BLITZLLVM_LEGACY_AUDIO_RESAMPLING` (first named `BLITZ_AUDIO_CLASSIC`) resamples like the original ([#77](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/77)).
- **Compiler:** `-W` levels with `-W<name>`, `-Wno-<name>` and `-Werror` ([#93](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/93)); the original `blitzcc` options `-q`, `+q`, `-c`, `-d`, `-k`, `+k`, `-v`, and `blitzcc` without `-o` runs the program ([#13](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/13)); userlibs are called and loaded when the program runs ([#57](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/57), [#60](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/60)); warnings for a wrong `Return` type, functions, parameters and fields without a type, short type notation and unused results ([#119](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/119), [#127](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/127), [#130](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/130), [#134](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/134)). `blitz-format` and `blitz-tidy` fix these in source files ([#128](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/128), [#129](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/129)). Programs build with `-O3` and fast-math, inline the hot runtime and drop unused code ([#82](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/82), [#86](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/86), [#104](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/104)). `--profile` turns on the profiling timers ([#131](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/131)).
- **Debug builds (`-d`)** stop at handles that do not exist or are freed twice, and load and save on the spot ([#289](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/289)). A lost graphics device is recovered from ([#303](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/303)).
- **Input:** `RawInputs` (now `RawInput`) counts unaccelerated mouse movement and wheel fractions ([#281](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/281)); `Input` reads and draws in the window, `KeyHit` and `MouseHit` count presses ([#43](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/43)).
- **Original details:** `CreateListener` returns the listener entity ([#302](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/302)); `SetStatusText` returns nothing ([#299](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/299)); `Collisions` accepts any response ([#183](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/183)).
- **Releases** build from version tags, with daily, weekly, monthly and yearly builds, and Windows and Linux for arm64, and macOS for Intel and Apple silicon ([#79](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/79), [#126](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/126), [#170](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/170), [#172](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/172), [#181](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/181)).

### Builds and packaging

- Windows builds with clang and lld for the MinGW target ([#464](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/464)) and has an installer that offers to install LLVM with winget ([#494](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/494)); release tags are named after the compiler version ([#499](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/499)). Not verified: arm64 install.
- Tests run on Linux and Windows ([#374](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/374)); macOS builds, but there is no macOS device to test on.
- A security pass hardened the runtime: size limits on `String()`/`Replace()`, multiplayer packets, `.x` and DDS loading, a restricted library search path, and checks for unchecked allocations (`Out of memory.`) ([#323](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/323) to [#347](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/347), [#468](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/468) to [#474](https://github.com/Xaymar/BlitzLLVM/pull/474)).
